arrangement: A short natural improvised D-to-G chord change, credible voicings/string attacks and up/downstroke dynamics. Release the last stroke early enough for its decay to finish INSIDE four seconds. Tone/feel prototype, not the full four-bar audition.

musicianship.technique: Modest, physically credible rhythm-player voicings; no virtuoso lead performance.
musicianship.timing: Consistent basic pulse and believable strum timing.
musicianship.originality: Small improvised variation within the agreed progression.
musicianship.feel: Relaxed rhythmic dynamics, close electric/small-room sound.
musicianship.versatility: Keep to this one requested rhythm role; no invented broader ability.
musicianship.presence: Restrained delivery appropriate to the audition room.
